title: Membrane-Based Clarification and Concentration in Bioprocess Downstream Operations for Regional Food and Pharmaceutical Producers

record.title: Membrane-Based Clarification and Concentration in Bioprocess Downstream Operations for Regional Food and Pharmaceutical Producers
record.programme: Science Fund of the Republic of Serbia (PROMIS, IDEAS, Prizma)
record.summary: The project addressed the gap between laboratory-scale fouling characterisation and the operating conditions encountered at small and medium-sized bioprocess facilities in Vojvodina. Research activities included systematic mapping of fouling regimes across protein types and concentration ranges relevant to regional dairy and fermentation industries, development of a decision-support framework for CIP protocol selection, and pilot-scale validation of TMP control strategies for irreversible fouling reduction. Four industrial partners provided authentic process streams for testing. A practical protocol guide was produced and disseminated to project partners. The project supported two doctoral students and resulted in five peer-reviewed journal publications.
